info.name: CalisHealth - Auth API (Pro)
info.description:
Test dang ky -> verify -> dang nhap voi email gia, KHONG can mailbox that.

## Cau truc bien (2 nhom tach biet)
| Nhom | Bien | Dung cho |
|---|---|---|
| User tam | `newUserEmail` (tu sinh), `newUserPassword` | vong register -> verify -> login |
| Tai khoan co dinh | `seedEmail` = test1@example.com, `seedPassword` | login thang, khong can verify |
| Di cap | `token` + `tokenEmail` | JWT va chu cua no - luon set cung luc |

## Tai khoan co dinh
`test1@example.com` / `Test@123` - da verify, login duoc ngay (request 10).

## Vi sao tach `tokenEmail`?
`token` va `tokenEmail` duoc ghi trong cung mot script login, nen `/me` luon so sanh dung.
Neu dung chung `testEmail` cho ca user tam lan tai khoan co dinh, chay xen ke se khien `/me` bao do du API tra ve dung.

## Chuan bi
1. MySQL dang chay + database `calishealth` (ddl-auto: update tu tao bang).
2. Chay Spring Boot (port 8080).

## Chay test
1. Bam **Run collection** (chay tu tren xuong duoi) - email se tu sinh moi moi lan chay nen khong bao gio dinh "Email da duoc dang ky".
2. Request **2. Verify email** se bao loi vi `verifyToken` con rong - DAY LA BINH THUONG.
3. Sang tab **Console** cua Spring Boot, tim khoi `===== EMAIL TO ... =====`, copy UUID sau chu `token=`.
4. Dan vao collection variable `verifyToken` (bien mau dam o goc phai).
5. Chay lai tu request **2** tro di - lan nay pass het.

request.description:
BUOC THU CONG: lay UUID sau `token=` trong console log (email [CLH] Dat lai mat khau), dan vao bien `resetToken`.

Script tu cap nhat `newUserPassword` = `Reset@123` khi thanh cong, nen request 7 chay tiep duoc luon - khong can sua tay.

Tu backend v2 DTO yeu cau `confirmNewPassword` - tham so cung gia tri `newPassword` de tranh loi 400.

request.description:
Can JWT. `oldPassword` lay tu `newUserPassword` - luon khop mat khau hien tai, ke ca khi da chay request 6 (bien da tu duoc cap nhat).

Luu y: doi xong `newUserPassword` thanh `Change@123`, chay lai collection se tu sinh user moi nen khong anh huong.

Tu backend v2 DTO yeu cau `confirmNewPassword` - tham so cung gia tri `newPassword` de tranh loi 400.

Ky vong 401 voi message chung chung, khong lo email co ton tai.

Dung `tokenEmail` de luon bat loi email that, dung nhieu lan goi lai cung mot tai khoan.

exec: pm.test('khong phan biet sai email hay sai mat khau', () =>

request.description: Ky vong 401 do SecurityConfig chi permitAll cho /api/auth/** tru /me va /change-password.

Tai khoan co dinh `test1@example.com` - da verify san nen login thang, khong can vong register/verify.

Chay request nay de test `/me` va doi mat khau ma khong can dang ky lai.

Dung `seedEmail`/`seedPassword` rieng, KHONG ghi de `newUserEmail` - nen chay xen ke voi vong register van khong vo.
